sts.armoury.export.tooltip: Copies a shareable STS builder link for the current loadout to your clipboard. Shift+click skips the name prompt.
sts.armoury.save.tooltip: Saves the current loadout to your STS profile (if linked) and copies its short link. Shift+click skips the name prompt.
sts.armoury.link.tooltip: Links your Minecraft profile to your Discord account so builds save to your profile.
sts.naming.title: Name the build
sts.naming.hint: The build is saved under this name (50 characters max). Leave it empty to keep the default.

Export Link on left
